notice: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER ASSUMPTIONS. No bank data, no pilot measurement and no interview data was available when these values were written. Every parameter below is a question for the pilot, not a known quantity. The base case is deliberately close to break-even: a comfortable base would be a fabricated base.

n_clients.note: Illustrative pilot reach for one language. NOT a confirmed bank population.

q_risk_episodes_per_client_year.note: Prevalence assumption: share of clients with a drop-risk episode in a year. Deliberately conservative and NOT measured; it scales the entire benefit side.

delta_incremental_prevention.note: Share of risk episodes prevented ONLY because of the new communication layer, on top of existing protection. Requires an approved treatment template and a powered A/B to confirm.

l_bank_rubles_per_episode.note: Bank loss per prevented drop episode. No bank data available; bundles recovery effort, fraud handling and write-off assumptions.

contacts_per_client_year.note: Client-initiated support contacts per client per year across the pilot population.

minutes_saved_per_contact.note: Agent minutes saved because a structured sandbox case arrives with context. UNVERIFIED.

cost_per_minute_rubles.note: Fully loaded agent cost per minute.

false_alerts_per_client_year.note: Derived from SYNTHETIC fixture false-alert rates only. NOT validated bank precision.

call_share_after_false_alert.note: Share of false alerts that trigger a support call.

handling_cost_per_contact_rubles.note: Cost of handling one false-alert contact.

k_initial_cost.note: One-off cost: build, bank integration, translation review, legal review, security review, pilot setup.

opex_annual.note: Annual run cost: maintenance, template re-review, monitoring, data-contract upkeep, evaluation reruns.

pinned_zero.note: Revenue uplift is unproven, cashback is not part of this layer, and there is no ML inference to pay for.
